Our purpose

Every book has a story.
So do we.

This & That is a mobile bookstore, run out of a vintage camper that folds open into a tiny shop. We travel with vintage-style books and handmade crafts — coffee mugs, portrait frames, bowls, and greeting cards.

We do this to deliver stories of all kinds, and to share them. In the end, life is all about our stories, our connections, and how we connect together. The words and the crafts we bring are what hold us to one another.

“The things we hold are how we hold each other.”

Share your story

What we pass along,
we keep.

If a book or a bowl found you at the camper, we’d love to hear how it settled into your life. Bring a note next time you visit, or send one along.

The notes below are fictional samples, written for this design — not real customer stories.

  • I found a cookbook that smelled like my grandmother’s kitchen. I sat on the rug outside the camper and didn’t want to leave.

    — M., Athens

  • We bought a bowl on a Sunday and have used it every dinner since. It feels like it already knew our table.

    — J. & R.

  • The camper was parked in a field at dusk. String lights, a stack of poetry, and a stranger who recommended a book I still think about.

    — A.K.

A letter from the road

We’ll save you a place in the grass.

A few times a season we write with where the camper will be, and what we’ve found along the way. No fuss. No crowd of emails.
